junctionLabelMeasurement.note: a label on a junction protects the LINK OBJECT, not its target; a link's own label is never accepted as coverage

contract.identityBeforeType: lstat precedes any statSync type gate, so a file-directed link is classified rather than skipped
contract.protectionBasis: the set of roots whose label was VERIFIED, never the declared set
contract.dependencyException: an out-of-domain target is admitted only when it resolves under a declared dependency root (the DSH installation the host runs from); everything else refuses
contract.noCatchAll: there is deliberately no rule admitting arbitrary external paths
contract.disclosure: every out-of-domain link stays recorded and `reparseBasis` still reports REPARSE_LEAVES_PROTECTION_DOMAIN

testIds: S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 1. a NORMAL protected tree completes with no reparse points
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 2. a protected root with an UNLABELLED child is not admission-eligible
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 3. a DIRECTORY JUNCTION into protected content is classified by its target
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 4. a FILE-DIRECTED link is classified rather than gated out — F4
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 5. a link into another ACTUALLY VERIFIED root is accounted for
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 6. a link into a DECLARED BUT UNLABELLED root is NOT covered — F5
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 7. a link into a QUALIFIED dependency root is admitted, and reported as such
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 8. a link into an UNKNOWN external root refuses even when a dependency contract exists
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 9. a BROKEN link is unresolvable and refuses admission
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 10. a reparse target REPLACED after admission is caught by the next verification
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 11. the traversal depth and entry limits still bound the walk and never PASS
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 12. a FULLY ENUMERATED root with no derived siblings is not a confidentiality failure
S1R-C reparse classification (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 13. a REAL DSH dependency layout classifies installer junctions without refusing the tree
S1R-C descendant qualification consumes the corrected basis (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 14. ensureReadFence passes the VERIFIED roots as the basis, not the declared set
S1R-C descendant qualification consumes the corrected basis (DYNAMICALLY_VERIFIED) 15. an out-of-domain link makes descendantsQualified FALSE

limits: a file-directed symlink cannot be created on this host (EPERM: privilege not held, Developer Mode off); that case is SOURCE_DEMONSTRATED
a junction aimed at a file is created but is BROKEN (statSync ENOENT), so it cannot demonstrate a read-through
a reparse target replaced after admission is caught by the NEXT verification; the runtime basis is the kernel label and the alias scan, not this walk
